how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-hillsbrad-foothills-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:561:obj:0: Speak with Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:561:details:0: Please inform Lieutenant Orinelle that I would like him to refocus his efforts on the naga infesting the Eastern Strand. When he has results, tell him to report to me in person.
rows.quest:561:completion:0: The naga, eh? Redpath must have just received the same information as me... Ha! He'll not receive a promotion from my toil. Let me explain.
rows.quest:562:obj:0: Kill 10 Daggerspine Shorehunters and 10 Daggerspine Sirens for Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:562:details:0: My former mentor in the ⟦E2⟧ city guard sent a message to me that ⟦E3⟧ High Command is becoming concerned with the threat posed by the naga. From what he's heard, there's good chances for promotion--or at least reassignment--for anyone who proves valuable in this regard.
rows.quest:562:details:1: BThere's just one small problem... I can't handle the naga, ⟦1⟧. Oh sure, I could break up a drunken barroom brawl, or haul off a belligerent beggar, but the naga are too much for me. You've got to help me, ⟦2⟧!
rows.quest:562:completion:0: With the naga put down in ⟦E1⟧, I'll be a shoe-in to be reassigned. I'll get to see ⟦E2⟧ again... get away from this Light-forsaken port.
rows.quest:563:obj:0: Deliver Farren's report to Major Samuelson in ⟦E2⟧ Keep.
rows.quest:563:details:0: It shouldn't be a problem getting my report seen. The new captain of the guard, Major Samuelson, was my mentor while I was stationed in ⟦E2⟧. It should give him more than enough excuse to have me transferred back to the city. I'll need you to carry my report to him, though... wouldn't want ol' Redpath to catch on.
rows.quest:563:completion:0: What's this? Ah... so my attentive pupil has applied himself to the problem of the naga in ⟦E1⟧. Thank you for bringing this to me, I will certainly take it into account when I review personnel assignments in the next month.
rows.quest:564:obj:0: Darren Malvew of ⟦E1⟧ wants you to kill 8 Mountain Lions and 10 Hulking Mountain Lions.
rows.quest:564:details:0: Ain't nothin' that irks me more than losin' these here beautiful horses. And believe me, we've lost quite a few between them pesky undead creeps, the dang ⟦E4⟧ gang and all the other good-for-nothin' scoundrels pokin' about these parts.
rows.quest:564:details:1: BBut I swear on my ol' grand-daddy's grave there ain't no bigger menace to our horses here than them Mountain Lions up in Alterac. Always comin' down from the hills and makin' my life difficult!
rows.quest:564:details:2: BYou fancy yourself a hero? Go and do somethin' about it then!
rows.quest:564:completion:0: Ain't that great news! Should-a gone and found me a regular ol' war hero from day one to take care of them beasts. You'd-a made your pappy proud, ⟦3⟧.
rows.quest:565:obj:0: Bring Bartolo Ginsetti of ⟦E1⟧ a Bolt of Wool, a Hillman's Cloak, Fine Thread and 10 clumps of Yeti Fur.
rows.quest:565:details:0: I, the great Bartolo, shall make for you the world famous, ⟦E3⟧ renowned, Yeti Fur Cloak!
rows.quest:565:details:1: BTravel the planet and find yourself a better cloak, I dare you. Oh wait, what is that, little ⟦4⟧? "Bartolo, there is no finer cloak!" Yes, yes! That, I have heard before.
rows.quest:565:details:2: BBartolo requires a Bolt of Wool, a Hillman's Cloak made by a skilled leatherworker, Fine Thread and Yeti Fur, of course! Bring to me these items and you shall be a happy customer!
rows.quest:565:completion:0: Now it is time for the great Bartolo to work his magic! I require no wizard's staff, no mage's rod. For I, the great Bartolo, work magic with a mere needle and thread!
rows.quest:566:obj:0: Kill Baron Vardus and deliver his head to High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:566:details:0: By order of High Executor Darthalia, the human known as Baron Vardus is wanted for crimes against the ⟦E5⟧. Vardus is known to be a high-ranking member of the organization known as the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:566:details:1: BHe was last spotted in the Uplands in the ⟦E6⟧, north of Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:566:details:2: BHe is wanted dead. Bring evidence of his demise to High Executor Darthalia to claim the reward.
rows.quest:566:completion:0: Productive work you do, ⟦5⟧. With Baron Vardus dead, the number of ⟦E4⟧ leaders grows smaller. Their resistance and irritation will be short-lived.
rows.quest:567:obj:0: High Executor Darthalia of Tarren Mill is offering a bounty on Clerk Horrace Whitesteed, Citizen Wilkes, Miner Hackett and Farmer Kalaba.
rows.quest:567:details:1: BThe following humans of Hillsbrad have been deemed dangerous and are marked for bounty by High Executor Darthalia:
rows.quest:567:details:2: BClerk Horrace Whitesteed. Wanted for the murder of Deathguard Toma.
rows.quest:567:details:3: BCitizen Wilkes. Wanted for the murder of Apothecary Eli.
rows.quest:567:details:4: BMiner Hackett. Wanted for the murder of Deathstalker Fry.
rows.quest:567:details:5: BFarmer Kalaba. Wanted for the ambush of supplies from the ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:567:details:6: BAll of these enemies are hiding and will be hard to find. A reward will be granted upon notice of their death.
rows.quest:567:completion:0: You are quite the bounty hunter, ⟦6⟧. Well done.
rows.quest:657:details:0: <Quae begins to go through the folder.>
rows.quest:657:details:1: BThis IS interesting. Seems Apothecary Jorell has been working on some deadly experiments here at Go'Shek. Not sure what that has to do with Hillsbrad, but Phin wouldn't like it if we let it continue.
rows.quest:657:details:2: BWe had a run-in with some orcs while you were gone, and I'm not in good enough shape to help Kinelory. If you're up for it, she's going to need some protection when she goes down to the farm to steal whatever research Jorell still hasn't sent to Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:657:completion:0: If it brings Phin peace, I'll destroy every single one of the ⟦E5⟧ personally. He's done so much for us since the plague. We never thought we'd find friends or family again.
rows.quest:657:completion:1: BWhen you're prepared, come let me know. We'll get started right away.
rows.quest:658:obj:0: Find the ⟦E5⟧ Courier and bring back her Sealed Folder to Quae near the Go'Shek Farm.
rows.quest:658:details:0: So, Phin sent you to check on us? Not surprised--he worries too much.
rows.quest:658:details:1: BWe've been watching the farm for days, and Kin claims she saw a courier come out of that small house to the south not long ago.
rows.quest:658:details:2: BShe talks a lot, but I can always trust her senses when we're in dangerous areas.
rows.quest:658:details:3: BYou wouldn't happen to be a skilled tracker, would you? We think the courier might be carrying notes to Tarren Mill. If we could get our hands on those documents, it might shed some light on what's happening in Hillsbrad.
rows.quest:658:completion:1: BLet's see what this is about...
rows.quest:659:obj:0: Find Quae and Kinelory near the Go'Shek Farm in the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:659:details:0: Hail, and well met, ⟦7⟧. I lead a group of adventurers investigating odd happenings in this area.
rows.quest:659:details:1: BMy cousin in Hillsbrad recently put down his dog Stanley because the animal mystically grew to an immense size and savagely attacked anyone who came near him.
rows.quest:659:details:2: BI believe the undead are involved, and we're looking for signs to prove as much.
rows.quest:659:details:3: BTwo of my companions, Quae and Kinelory, headed to the Go'Shek Farm in the ⟦E8⟧, and haven't checked in for days. Find them for me? I grow concerned.
rows.quest:659:completion:0: Try and stay as quiet as possible, traveler.
rows.quest:659:completion:1: BOrcs don't take too well to being spied on, and there is more to this farm than meets the eye.
rows.quest:660:obj:0: Protect Kinelory until she returns to Quae.
rows.quest:660:details:0: All right, ⟦8⟧. I'm ready if you are.
rows.quest:660:completion:0: You've done a great service for us, ⟦9⟧. Thank you.
rows.quest:660:completion:1: BI hope Kin wasn't too much of a handful down there. She's very friendly, but can be just as deadly when you're her enemy.
rows.quest:661:details:0: I've seen Kinelory look way worse after a night in the tavern than she does now. You obviously did a good job protecting her.
rows.quest:661:details:1: BThese items she brought back from the farm should at least let Phin get an idea of what's going on out here in Arathi. Just to make sure there's no retaliation after your attack, we're going to stay here for a bit longer. Would you be willing to head back to ⟦E1⟧ and talk to Phin?
rows.quest:661:completion:0: So, the two troublemakers are all right after all? Haha, I'm glad to hear it. I thank you for bringing me news of their whereabouts and status--it pleases me greatly that they are still alive; the two of them are irreplaceable as friends and traveling companions.
rows.quest:661:completion:1: BBut... it's more important I thank you properly for your help. Here. Take this along with my group's thanks.
rows.quest:661:completion:2: BWith any luck, we'll figure out what the ⟦E5⟧ are up to, and put an end to it.
rows.quest:676:obj:0: Kill 8 Boulderfist Ogres and 10 Boulderfist Enforcers, then find Drum Fel in the Hammerfall outpost in ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:676:details:0: Weaklings... all of them. You, ⟦10⟧, what are you looking at? Think you're something special, huh? Why not prove it?
rows.quest:676:details:1: BThe Hammerfall outpost in Arathi's under attack. Unless we send them help soon, their demise is imminent.
rows.quest:676:details:2: BBut before you go rushing off, you may want to test your skills first. Northeast of Stromgarde in Arathi is an ogre mound inhabited by the Boulderfist tribe. When you can handle the ogres and enforcers there, then report to Drum Fel in Hammerfall.
rows.quest:676:completion:0: So, you think you're strong enough to help Hammerfall? So be it.
rows.quest:676:completion:1: BTallow either sent you to that ogre mound in the hopes that you would kill yourself or he thinks you're strong enough to aid us. Either way, you're here now and I am in need of more soldiers in our fight against the constant attacks.
rows.quest:676:completion:2: BIf you plan on staying in Hammerfall then get some rest, and come speak to me again when you're ready. There's no shortage of fighting to be had.
